gloss: follow-up medical visit; re-examination (by a doctor)

definitions.gloss: follow-up medical visit; re-examination (by a doctor)
definitions.explanation: A return visit to a doctor or clinic by a patient who has already been seen for the same condition. Contrasts with {初診|しょしん} (the first visit). It is a key billing term in the Japanese medical system, since re-examinations are charged at a different rate than first visits.

examples.japanese: {再診|さいしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧。
⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧、{再診|さいしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: Next week I'll go to the hospital for a follow-up visit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初診|しょしん}→初診：11090_shoshin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料金|りょうきん}→料金：03797_ryoukin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{再診|さいしん}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{設定|せってい}→設定：04767_settei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧だ。
examples.english: In most cases, the fee for a first visit is set higher than that for a follow-up visit.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ (again, re-) and {診|しん} (medical examination, diagnosis). Used specifically for a second or later visit by the same patient to the same clinic for the same condition. It appears on medical receipts, insurance forms, and hospital signs. Can be used as a verb with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: {再診|さいしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (for the doctor to re-examine a patient).

This word is a homophone of ⟦{再審|さいしん}→再審：15180_saishin⟧ (retrial) and ⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧ (newest). Context — hospital, clinic, appointment — makes the meaning unambiguous.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再診|さいしん}{料|りょう}: re-examination fee
- {再診|さいしん}⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧: follow-up appointment
- {再診|さいしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive a follow-up examination
- {再診|さいしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧: at the time of a follow-up visit

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{初診|しょしん}→初診：11090_shoshin⟧: first visit — the opposite term
- ⟦{診察|しんさつ}→診察：03259_shinsatsu⟧: medical examination (general)
- ⟦{受診|じゅしん}→受診：11890_jushin⟧: seeing a doctor, consultation
- ⟦{通院|つういん}→通院：05975_tsuuin⟧: going to the hospital/clinic as an outpatient (repeatedly)
